instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium full shot. In a sunny park with green grass, three friends celebrate. On the left, the bald man in a dark blue t-shirt (R2) stands facing right, laughing heartily. In the center, the large Black man in a black t-shirt (R1) stands facing right, laughing. On the right, the woman in a dark blue t-shirt and light blue jeans (R4) stands facing left, laughing. They stand close together in a joyful circle. Warm, natural sunlight illuminates the scene.
elements: R1 occupies the central position in the close celebratory group rather than R2
R4 takes the inward-facing role from one side of the group rather than R1 taking that role
R2 takes the opposite inward-facing role toward the group rather than R4
R1, R2, and R4 stand close together in a joyful circle
R1, R2, and R4 are laughing together
